fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim dense vegetation along both sides of the access drive to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Clear vegetation growth that narrows or overhangs the access drive to maintain full vehicle-width clearance.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the main residence and detached structure to give responders a clear path around both buildings.
• Keep the access drive surface clear of debris so vehicles can reach the property without delay.
• Trim shrubs and trees along the access drive that block sightlines, so approaching responders can see the structures before reaching them.
• Mark the detached structure with a visible identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence on arrival.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings quickly.
• If the detached structure has a separate entry point, mark it visibly so responders can locate it without searching through surrounding vegetation.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back all trees and shrubs that touch or overhang the roof, walls, or deck of the house.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation or exterior walls on all sides of the house.
• Thin the tree clusters near the house so branches do not touch between trees.
• Cut lower branches off trees near the house up to at least 10 feet from the ground.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and plant material from the roof and gutters regularly.
• Remove or thin shrubs growing beneath trees near the structure to reduce connected vegetation between the ground and the tree canopy.
• Scatter and separate shrubs around the house so there are clear gaps of bare ground between individual plants.
• Keep the single driveway clear of overhanging branches from edge to edge along its full length.
• Make sure the driveway entrance is clearly visible and wide enough for emergency vehicles to enter and turn around.
• Mark the driveway address at the road with a sign that is visible from both directions.
• Move any wood piles, propane tanks, or other stored materials away from the exterior walls of the house.
• Mow or cut down tall grass in the open green space areas close to the house before dry season.
